s: Ottoman-inspired café blending Middle Eastern hospitality with specialty coffee
w: A Middle Eastern-inspired café near Charing Cross serving specialty coffee alongside Turkish-influenced food and pastries. Praised for its warmth and hospitality as much as its cups, it has climbed into global best-coffee-shop rankings and is regularly cited as one of Glasgow's most distinctive independent cafés.
_facts: Located at 73 Berkeley Street, Glasgow G3 7DX
Blends Ottoman/Middle Eastern food and hospitality with specialty coffee
Open Tuesday to Sunday, closed Mondays
Featured in global best-coffee-shop rankings and Glasgow food and drink guides
